en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed who said,

‘I and Ibn Gaylan Al-Madainy had gone to Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup>. So Ibn Gaylan said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you<sup>asws</sup> well! It has reached me that the one who had a pregnancy for him, so he makes the intention that he would be naming him as Muhammad, a boy would be born unto him’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who had a pregnancy for him, so he makes the intention that he would name him as Ali, a boy would be born unto him’.
Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, and Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> Ali<sup>asws</sup> is one thing’.

He said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you<sup>asws</sup> well! I left behind my wife and she was with a pregnancy, therefore supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that He<sup>azwj</sup> may Make him a boy’. So he<sup>asws</sup> was silent for a long time, then raised his<sup>asws</sup> head, so he<sup>asws</sup> said to him: ‘Name him Ali for it would be a prolongation for his life’.
So we entered Makkah, so there came to us a letter from Al-Madainy that there had been born a boy for him’.
en.sarwar: It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Muhammad ibn Ali from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id who has said the following: “Once ibn Ghaylan al-Mada’iniy and I visited abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and ibn Ghaylan said to him (the Imam), ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, I have been informed that if one’s wife is pregnant and he keeps his intention to name him Muhammad a son then is born to him.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘If one’s wife is pregnant and he keeps in his intention to name him Ali, (in this case also) a son will born to him.’ He (the Imam) then said, ‘Ali and Muhammad is one thing.’

He then said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep you well, I left my wife pregnant, please pray to Allah to make him a boy.’ He (the Imam) bent down his head for a long time; then raised his head and said, ‘Name him Ali because it is good for his long life.’
We then entered Makkah and a letter came from al-Mada’in saying, “A boy is born to him.’””
